$schema.description: Lets your editor check this file and suggest fields. Leave it as it is.

id.description: Must match the file name: "naija-back-to-school" for naija-back-to-school.json.

name.description: What players see on the home page, e.g. "Naija Charades (Back to School Edition)".

tagline.description: One line under the name on the home page.

items.description: Must match the file name: "movies-90s" for movies-90s.json.

packs.description: The ids of the game's packs to play, e.g. ["back-to-school"].

tags.description: Optional. Only play items with at least one of these tags. Leave out to play every item.

items.description: Lowercase words joined by hyphens, e.g. "snack" or "tv-show".

settings.description: The settings that differ from the game's defaults, e.g. { "mode": "clock", "seconds": 90 }.

open.description: The settings players may change, e.g. ["rounds", "seconds", "mode"]. Teams are always open.

contributors.description: GitHub usernames of the people who wrote the pack, without "@". Add yours.
